observations: White wooden toddler bed with safety rails on three sides.
Integrated small slide and a three-step staircase.
Two large storage drawers at the base of the bed.
Prominent watermark 'BEST WORLD FURNITURE' across the center of the image.
Professional lighting, staging, and background suggest a catalog or stock photo.

identity.kind: Toddler bed with slide and drawers

risks.risk: The photo is a watermarked stock image; the actual item may not exist or be in the possession of the seller.
risks.proof: A photo of the bed in a domestic setting with a handwritten note showing the seller's name and today's date.

risks.risk: Structural integrity and material quality (e.g., solid wood vs. low-grade MDF).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the joints, underside, and any unfinished edges.
risks.if_unproven: as low-grade composite material with loose joints

risks.risk: Missing assembly hardware or internal slats.
risks.proof: A photo of the bed disassembled showing all screws, bolts, and the mattress support base.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual bed in its current location with a handwritten note showing today's date.
Close-up photos of the wood grain and joints to verify material and condition.
Photos of the drawers opened to check the runners and internal condition.
response.reason: The seller has provided a single, watermarked catalog photo rather than a photo of the actual item. In remote second-hand sales, this is a primary indicator of a scam.
